title: Let Vaporize auto-increment build numbers before build and install collapse
createdBy: mono per operator realization: Vaporize can auto increment build numbers
problem: Concourse exposed the release-quality failure mode: source fixes can build and install while stale and fresh bundles still report the same MARKETING_VERSION and CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION. Operators and QA cannot reliably tell which binary they are running.
decision: Vaporize should become the build-number authority for substrate app collapse by reusing or graduating the existing Hack Nu plist/agvtool utility workflow, not by inventing a second plist mutator. Before build/install/run collapse, Vaporize increments the app build number, writes the change into the project surface, and emits a receipt proving the before/after identity.
scope: Detect Xcode app project build-number surfaces including XcodeGen project.yml CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION, generated .xcodeproj build settings, and Info.plist CFBundleVersion where applicable.
Support an explicit auto-increment mode for app build/install routes.
Support a dry-run mode that reports the next build number without modifying files.

Emit a typed build-number receipt with previousBuildNumber, nextBuildNumber, version, projectPath, scheme, configuration, bundleIdentifier, destinationBundlePath, and git/worktree context where available.
Make the build-number receipt joinable to Vaporize install receipts, Warehouse entries, and Concourse in-app health.
Reuse the Hack Nu plist utility workflow or its substrate-shared graduation instead of hand-rolling plist mutation inside Vaporize.
Support Hack Nu-style Fastlane/agvtool projects, XcodeGen project.yml apps, and direct Info.plist SPM app bundles through one build-number primitive.
acceptanceCriteria: Vaporize increments CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION exactly once per build/install collapse unless --no-auto-increment-build is supplied.
Vaporize refuses to claim install success if the installed bundle's CFBundleVersion does not match the receipt's nextBuildNumber.
Vaporize supports dry-run output so QA can see the planned version/build identity before collapse.
Vaporize writes or updates a typed BuildNumberReceiptModel v0.0.1 candidate with before/after build identity.
Vaporize records whether the increment touched project.yml, pbxproj, Info.plist, or another declared source of truth.
Vaporize detects dirty worktree risk before mutating build-number files and requires an explicit policy for dirty trees.
Concourse app installs can no longer produce two different binaries with the same visible version/build pair.
Warehouse can answer: which build number is the latest installed Concourse debug build?
Vaporize build-number mutation is implemented by the Hack Nu plist/agvtool workflow or its substrate-shared successor, not a second bespoke plist writer.
Vaporize can report which adapter performed the mutation: agvtool, project.yml, pbxproj, direct Info.plist, or mixed target alignment.
Hack Nu, Concourse, Vault-family, and SPM-only app bundles share the same previous-plus-one build-number rule.
qaAcceptance: Run dry-run and verify nextBuildNumber is one greater than current build number.
Run build/install collapse and verify project source, built app Info.plist, installed app Info.plist, Vaporize receipt, and Concourse in-app health all report the same nextBuildNumber.
Run a second build/install collapse and verify build number increments again.
Verify stale installed bundles with lower build numbers are classified as stale by install topology QA.
Verify no app launch path opens a lower build number without a stale-build warning.
nonGoals: Do not make build-number increments an invisible side effect with no receipt.
Do not hard-code Concourse-only behavior into Vaporize; Concourse is the first product proving the need.
Do not use build-number increments as a substitute for stale-bundle cleanup or launch-route QA.

implementationReuse.canonicalSource: Hack Nu plist utility / Fastlane + agvtool build-number workflow, to be lifted into the substrate-shared bump-build primitive rather than duplicated inside Vaporize
implementationReuse.existingRule: CFBundleVersion = previous + 1, starting at 0; CFBundleShortVersionString and CFBundleVersion remain typed-distinct; only build advances per cadence
requiredAdapters: Xcode project and agvtool adapter for Hack Nu-style projects
XcodeGen project.yml CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION adapter for Concourse and Vault-family apps
direct Info.plist CFBundleVersion adapter for SPM-only app bundles
extension/widget alignment adapter so embedded targets match the containing app
implementationReuse.vaporizeRole: orchestrator and receipt issuer; calls the shared plist/build-number primitive before app collapse and verifies the built/installed app version surfaces afterward
